items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wrote a show called Sing Me a Jazz Song. I had Leon Thomas, Eddie, Annie, and me.

ctx.x: So did you have a bond or friendship for any period of time?

Yeah. Oh sure. I wrote a show for – what’s the station in Chicago? WBGH? Whatever it is. Chicago t.v. station – I wrote a show called Sing Me a Jazz Song. I had Leon Thomas, Eddie, Annie, and me. I’ve got a tape of that. I’ll make you a copy of that.
